title: Error
description: Every OLIP 2.0-draft error response. Codes are stable; messages are plain language and may change.

code.description: Codes a host returns: OLIP_AGENT_CANNOT_APPROVE, OLIP_APPROVAL_ALREADY_DECIDED, OLIP_APPROVAL_CODE_INVALID, OLIP_APPROVAL_LOCKED, OLIP_ATTENDANCE_SOURCE_REQUIRED, OLIP_AUTHORIZATION_EXPIRED, OLIP_CALLBACK_URL_REJECTED, OLIP_CONFLICT_STAGE_REQUIRED, OLIP_CONSENT_DIGEST_MISMATCH, OLIP_CONSULTATION_SLOT_EXPIRED, OLIP_CONSULTATION_SLOT_MISMATCH, OLIP_DELEGATION_REVOKED, OLIP_DISCLOSURE_NOT_AUTHORIZED, OLIP_DOCUMENT_NOT_CLEARED, OLIP_DOCUMENT_REJECTED, OLIP_ENGAGEMENT_OFFER_CHANGED, OLIP_ENGAGEMENT_OFFER_EXPIRED, OLIP_EVENT_CONFLICT, OLIP_EVENT_REPLAYED, OLIP_EVENT_SIGNATURE_INVALID, OLIP_EVENT_STALE, OLIP_FIELD_NOT_ALLOWED, OLIP_FIRM_AUTHORITY_REQUIRED, OLIP_FORBIDDEN, OLIP_IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT, OLIP_IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REQUIRED, OLIP_INTERNAL, OLIP_INVALID_REQUEST, OLIP_KEY_REVOKED, OLIP_LIFECYCLE_TRANSITION_INVALID, OLIP_NOT_FOUND, OLIP_PASSPORT_INVALID, OLIP_PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE, OLIP_POLICY_GATE_CLOSED, OLIP_RATE_LIMITED, OLIP_RECIPIENT_NOT_USER_SELECTED, OLIP_REVISION_CONFLICT, OLIP_REVISION_REQUIRED, OLIP_SCHEMA_INVALID, OLIP_SENSITIVE_DATA_BLOCKED, OLIP_THREAD_CLOSED, OLIP_THREAD_MEMBERSHIP_REQUIRED, OLIP_TOKEN_EXPIRED, OLIP_UNAUTHENTICATED. Client libraries may also raise: OLIP_HTTP_ERROR, OLIP_NOT_NEGOTIATED, OLIP_PROFILE_NOT_SUPPORTED.
